eventMetadata.context_description: Cercle Brugge hosts Lommel SK in Belgian Pro League matchweek 4 after a slow start that includes a 2-2 draw at Standard Liège, a 3-3 home draw with Sint-Truiden, and a 0-1 Bruges derby loss to Club Brugge. Cercle has conceded six goals in three matches while struggling to convert home opportunities. Lommel arrives in stronger early form with four points from three games, capped by a 4-0 win over Westerlo that showcased efficient attacking play and defensive organization. No significant injuries or suspensions are reported for either side. Historical head-to-heads remain limited and low-scoring, with the match at Jan Breydel Stadion offering Cercle a chance to improve its record against a Lommel side adapting to top-flight competition.
